name: defender-xdr
description: Read-only Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting tools and investigation skills for Claude Code

tenant_id.title: Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: GUID of the Microsoft Entra tenant to query. Find it in Entra ID > Overview.

client_id.title: Entra application (client) ID
client_id.description: GUID of a public-client app registration with redirect URI http://localhost and admin-consented delegated Microsoft Graph ThreatHunting.Read.All. Not a secret, and client secrets are never accepted.

api_base_url.title: Microsoft Graph endpoint
api_base_url.description: Change only for sovereign clouds: https://graph.microsoft.us (US Gov) or https://microsoftgraph.chinacloudapi.cn (China).

maximum_rows.title: Maximum rows per query
maximum_rows.description: Ceiling on rows returned to Claude. Queries cannot exceed this.

default_lookback.title: Default lookback window
default_lookback.description: Timespan used when a query does not specify one, such as 7d or 24h.

allow_unencrypted_token_cache.title: Allow unencrypted token cache
allow_unencrypted_token_cache.description: Only enable if your OS credential store is unavailable. Tokens are then written to an owner-only (0600) plaintext file instead of the Keychain.
